## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`uv run pytest`)
- [ ] New or changed parser output has a fixture (`uv run scripts/fixture.py add ...`)
- [ ] `uv run pre-commit run -a` passes (ruff, mypy, lockfile)
- [ ] Generated docs refreshed if commands or models changed (`uv run scripts/gen_docs.py`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased*
